$comment: Controller firmware release manifest. This is the seed of the OTA channel: fielded controllers poll /api/firmware/check with their model and current version, and the server answers from this file. Human-readable view lives at /firmware/.

channels.stable: Default for all fielded units. Promoted after 30 days on beta with no field regressions.
channels.beta: Opt-in. Requires a signed consent record against the unit serial.
channels.hold: No updates delivered. Set by ERS engineering when a regression is under investigation.

notes: Corrects a levelling overshoot on ER-6 centre-pair legs at low fluid temperature.
Adds LEG-A3 transducer self-identification on hot-swap.
Raises leg bus CRC error threshold reporting into W-405 instead of silent retry.
